mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases sharply but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases significantly but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the subsequent 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of the subsequent 5-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases significantly but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases, it indicates a tightening monetary policy to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 2% and CPIAUCSL increases but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the subsequent 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is below 5% and PAYEMS increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases significantly but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of the subsequent 5-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is decreasing and GDP (GDPC1) is below its 12-month moving average, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% in 3 months and GDPC1 < 12-month MA
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases and GDPC1 is below its 12-month MA but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the subsequent 60-day periods.
